description: Connect a Ramp corporate account to DPX settlement. Returns an OAuth authorization URL — direct the user to this URL to grant DPX access to their Ramp account. Required scopes: transactions:read, bills:read/write, cards:read/write, cards:read_agentic (Agent Cards), business:read, bank_accounts:read, vendors:read, entities:read. Call once per tenant; tokens are stored and refreshed automatically.

tenant_id.description: Your internal tenant or customer ID — returned in the callback so you can match the connection.

name: ramp.connect

authorize_url.description: Redirect the user to this URL to authorize DPX on their Ramp account.
